characterization_method.static: released valid speed in final 2 s; mean, min, max, population SD, peak-to-peak and consecutive deltas; compare run hashes
characterization_method.step: test-only PLC-typed open-loop commands; report audit ACTUAL separately; qualified online view uses only released speed and quality
characterization_method.reversal: measure old-direction trend persistence and first new-direction released movement from reversal timestamp; no epoch policy
characterization_method.loss_recovery: withhold pump-speed quality using existing sensor.failed mechanism; first VALID released record after recovery
characterization_method.mesh: same sensor sample/release schedule at 0.2/0.1/0.05-s physics integration mesh; report threshold-driving spread
characterization_method.modeled_noise: source audit; zero only if no perturbation exists in LocalMeasurement.sample
characterization_method.quantization: NOT_MODELED if no explicit rounding or digitization; never use float epsilon as sensor resolution

estimation_and_uncertainty.stationary_floor: maximum measured stationary peak-to-peak across all speeds/meshes/repeats
estimation_and_uncertainty.mesh_floor: maximum absolute difference in released measured speed at common timestamps for identical commands across meshes
estimation_and_uncertainty.quantization_floor: zero for deterministic numerical fixture only if quantization absent; hardware unknown
estimation_and_uncertainty.qualification_margin_rule: minimum_observable_speed_change = max(R5.2 preregistered 0.01 fraction, 2 * observation_floor); fixed before fault outcomes
estimation_and_uncertainty.justification: retain prior tested diagnostic floor and require a factor-two separation above measured stationary/mesh variation; generic fixture only
estimation_and_uncertainty.qualified_progress: released VALID speed displacement in demand direction >= minimum_observable_speed_change, with release time <= decision time and age <= configured max_age
estimation_and_uncertainty.step_observability: NOT_OBSERVABLE_FOR_TRACKING_QUALIFICATION if nominal measured displacement never reaches the threshold within registered 4-s window
estimation_and_uncertainty.response_open: first sensor release at or after command time + configured actuator command delay, with expected model displacement reaching threshold; report separately from fault confirmation
estimation_and_uncertainty.mesh_acceptance: threshold-driving floor spread must not change the resulting minimum_observable_speed_change across three meshes
estimation_and_uncertainty.conservation: max mass residual <= 1e-6 kg/s and max absolute step energy residual <= 1e-5 J
estimation_and_uncertainty.repeatability: identical canonical trace hash, first observable timestamp and conservation summary in each 10-run group
